_comment: CDW Agentic Pipeline — Segmentation Tool Registry. Verified against external/ codebases. Three active categories: fixed_class (predetermined label sets), text_promptable (free-text organ names from LLM planner), label_prompted (integer class indices or modality presets). Deferred tools are registered but not wired into the planner.

fixed_class_tools.name: TotalSegmentator_CT
fixed_class_tools.description: Segments 117 anatomical structures from CT images (organs, muscles, vessels, bones). nnU-Net based. Default and most widely validated CT segmentation model. Outputs per-organ NIfTI files + statistics.json.

fixed_class_tools.name: TotalSegmentator_MR
fixed_class_tools.description: MRI mode of TotalSegmentator. Segments 50 anatomical structures from MRI volumes, sequence-independent. Invoked with -ta total_mr flag.

fixed_class_tools.name: MRSegmentator
fixed_class_tools.description: Segments 40 anatomical classes from both MRI (T1, T2, Dixon) and CT. Good cross-modality abdominal coverage. Outputs a multilabel NIfTI; wrapper splits to per-organ.

fixed_class_tools.name: MRISegmenter
fixed_class_tools.description: 62-structure segmentation for T1-weighted abdominal MRI (15 organs, 7 vessels, 8 muscles, 32 bones/vertebrae). Specifically trained on pre-contrast and multi-phase contrast-enhanced T1w abdominal MRI. Outputs a combined multilabel NIfTI; wrapper splits to per-organ.

fixed_class_tools.name: VIBESegmentator
fixed_class_tools.description: Full-body segmentation for MRI and CT. 72 anatomical structures (organs, vessels, muscles, bones, fat compartments, spinal structures). Trained on NAKO and UK Biobank. Works on multiple MRI sequences despite the name.
fixed_class_tools.notes: Script-based tool; vibeseg_dir must point to the cloned repo. Dataset variant controlled by --dataset_id (default 100 = axial full-body).

fixed_class_tools.name: SynthSeg
fixed_class_tools.description: Contrast-agnostic brain MRI segmentation. SynthSeg outputs a 1mm isotropic multilabel brain segmentation; wrapper resamples labels back to image_nifti.nii.gz space and writes canonical per-structure masks plus a combined brain mask.
fixed_class_tools.notes: Brain/head MRI only. Set SYNTHSEG_DIR if the clone is not at external/SynthSeg. Wrapper uses --robust by default and nearest-neighbour resampling to restore the input image grid.
fixed_class_tools.reference: Billot et al., Medical Image Analysis 2023; PNAS 2023

text_promptable_tools.name: VoxTell
text_promptable_tools.description: Free-text-prompted universal 3D segmentation. Maps free-form text prompts (single words to full clinical sentences) to volumetric masks. Trained on 158 public datasets. Prompt encoder: frozen Qwen3-Embedding-4B. Use when fixed-class tools do not cover a specific target structure.
text_promptable_tools.prompt_source: LLM planner provides organ/structure names as free-text
text_promptable_tools.notes: PyTorch < 2.9 required (OOM bug in 2.9.0 with 3D convs). Images must be in RAS orientation.

text_promptable_tools.name: BiomedParse3D
text_promptable_tools.description: BiomedParse v2. Text-prompted 3D volumetric segmentation with BoltzFormer architecture. 200+ anatomies across CT, MRI, PET, Ultrasound, and 3D Microscopy. Processes volumes slice-by-slice with 3D context. Python API only (no CLI).
text_promptable_tools.prompt_source: LLM planner provides organ/structure names; multi-class prompt via [SEP] separator
text_promptable_tools.notes: CT input must be intensity-windowed and scaled to [0, 255]. Hydra config-based initialization.
text_promptable_tools.deferred_reason: detectron2 CUDA build too fragile; VoxTell + TextMedSeg3D provide equivalent 3D text-prompted coverage.

text_promptable_tools.name: BiomedParse2D
text_promptable_tools.description: BiomedParse v1. Text-prompted 2D segmentation across 9 biomedical imaging modalities (CT, MRI, Ultrasound, X-Ray, Pathology, Endoscopy, Dermoscopy, Fundus, OCT). 100+ classes. Python API only. DEFERRED — pipeline focuses on 3D volumes.
text_promptable_tools.prompt_source: LLM planner provides organ/structure names as text
text_promptable_tools.deferred_reason: Pipeline currently processes 3D volumes only. BiomedParse2D operates on individual 2D slices.

label_prompted_tools.name: VISTA3D
label_prompted_tools.description: NVIDIA VISTA3D — 345+ class CT/MRI segmentation foundation model. Trained on CT, finetuned on CT+MRI. Two prompt modes: (1) label_prompt: list of integer class indices for targeted segmentation; (2) modality preset: CT_BODY / MRI_BODY / MRI_BRAIN for automatic whole-organ segmentation. Python API only.

prompt_modes.label_prompt: List of integer class indices. Wrapper translates organ names → indices via ORGAN_TO_INDEX map.
prompt_modes.modality_preset: CT_BODY | MRI_BODY | MRI_BRAIN — segments all relevant structures for that modality.

label_prompted_tools.notes: Requires NVIDIA Ampere or Hopper GPU (A100, H100). Brain MRI requires skull stripping pre-processing.

deferred_tools.name: nnInteractive
deferred_tools.description: Interactive open-set 3D segmentation. Supports point, bounding box, scribble, and lasso prompts. Trained on 120+ diverse volumetric datasets. Intended as a post-hoc refinement step on top of auto-segmentation outputs, not for batch pipeline use.
deferred_tools.deferred_reason: Requires interactive visual prompts. Planned as a refinement add-on after automated segmentation: auto-seg outputs → generate bounding box prompts → nnInteractive refinement.
deferred_tools.notes: PyTorch < 2.9 required (OOM bug). Won CVPR 2025 Interactive 3D Segmentation Challenge.

deferred_tools.name: TextMedSeg3D
deferred_tools.description: SAT (Segment Anything Textual). Text-prompted 3D segmentation trained on 72 public datasets with 497 classes across CT, MRI, and PET. Covers 8 body regions. Invoked via torchrun subprocess with a JSONL input spec.
deferred_tools.prompt_source: LLM planner provides organ/structure names as text; passed as label_names list in JSONL
deferred_tools.notes: Input must be RAS orientation. JSONL format: {image, label_names, dataset, modality, orientation_code}. SAT-Pro (~34-62GB GPU); SAT-Nano (~24-36GB GPU).
deferred_tools.reference: SAT: Segment Anything in Medical Images with Text, 2024

deferred_tools.name: HybridGNet
deferred_tools.description: Anatomically constrained 2D segmentation of chest X-rays using hybrid graph neural networks. Outputs left lung, right lung, heart masks plus anatomical landmarks. DEFERRED — pipeline focuses on 3D CT/MRI volumes.
deferred_tools.deferred_reason: 2D chest X-ray only. Pipeline currently processes 3D CT/MRI volumes.
deferred_tools.notes: PyTorch 1.10 + PyTorch Geometric. Weights on Google Drive. IEEE TMI 2022.
